Dictionary_Elements.Item_Description: NCCR Persistent Identifier for the Data Platform

This field contains a unique number to indicate that this is a unique record within the Radiation Oncology dataset. Each radiation record represents a unique radiation event or series. Because exact dates are masked and records are presented in terms of months from index diagnosis, multiple records may appear to be identical. This field is provided to confirm to the user that these are unique records.

Permissible_Value_Details.Description: The unique record indicator number for a patient

Permissible_Values.Description: The unique record indicator number for a patient

Dictionary_Elements.Item_Description:
Sequence number indicating the order of radiation records, calculated based on start date. Each radiation record represents a unique radiation event or series. Because exact dates are masked and records are presented in terms of months from index diagnosis, multiple records may appear to take place in the same month. This field provides additional information to the user by informing them of the order in which records took place (based on start date), including whether records have the same start date.

For patients with known start dates for all radiation records, all sequence numbers start with digit 8 (i.e., 8XX). For patients with at least one radiation record with no known start date, all sequence numbers start with digit 9 (i.e., 9XX), and sequence numbers for records with no known start date are coded as 999. If multiple radiation records for a patient start on the same date, sequence numbers will be identical.

Info.label: Transformation Description
Info.Value:
These data were provided from multiple sources using various semantic encodings. To harmonize the submitted data, a common data element (CDE) from the NCI's Cancer Data Standards Registry and Repository (caDSR II) with permissible values in alignment with submitted values was selected and validated by a team of clinical oncology experts. Radiation Anatomic Site was harmonized to the CDE with Public ID 13362279. Submitted values corresponding to the harmonized data in this field can be found in the Untransformed Radiation Anatomic Site field.

For submitted values that map to more than one permissible value found in the chosen CDE, Radiation Anatomic Site will contain multiple concept codes separated by pipes (e.g., C##### | C#####). In some cases, a single unit exists in the chosen CDE that is made up of multiple concept codes; these are presented as multiple concept codes separated by colons (e.g., C#####:C#####).

Submitted values that represent a radiation anatomic site but do not map to a permissible value found in the chosen CDE are mapped to C17649 (Other). Submitted values that contain text that does not represent a radiation anatomic site are mapped to C17998 (Unknown). When submitted values for the Untransformed Radiation Anatomic Site field are empty, this field is mapped to C43234 (Not Reported).

Dictionary_Elements.Item_Description:
Harmonized anatomic site or region that radiation is delivered to. This field contains harmonized values mapped from the originally submitted data found in field Untransformed Radiation Anatomic Site.

Permissible values for this field include one or more NCIt concept codes in format C##### or C######. Missing values are mapped to C43234 (Not Reported).

For more details about mappings for this field, see Transformation Description.

For more details about specific NCIt concept codes, see Description or Long Description.

Dictionary_Elements.Item_Description:
Anatomic site or region that radiation is delivered to, in format of original submission.

Data describing radiation anatomic site were provided from multiple sources using various semantic encodings. This field corresponds to the originally submitted data and is used to create the harmonized variables found in field Radiation Anatomic Site. For more details, see Transformation Description for Radiation Anatomic Site.

Info.label: Transformation Description
Info.Value:
These data were provided from multiple sources using various semantic encodings. To harmonize the submitted data, a common data element (CDE) from the NCI's Cancer Data Standards Registry and Repository (caDSR II) with permissible values in alignment with submitted values was selected and validated by a team of clinical oncology experts. Radiation Therapy Type was harmonized to the CDE with Public ID 14956043. Submitted values corresponding to the harmonized data in this field can be found in the Untransformed Radiation Therapy Type field.

For submitted values that map to more than one permissible value found in the chosen CDE, Radiation Therapy Type will contain multiple concept codes separated by pipes (e.g., C##### | C#####).

Submitted values that represent a radiation therapy type but do not map to a permissible value found in the chosen CDE are mapped to C17649 (Other). Submitted values that contain text that does not represent a radiation therapy type are mapped to C17998 (Unknown). When submitted values for the Untransformed Radiation Therapy Type field are empty, this field is mapped to C43234 (Not Reported).

In some cases, information about radiation therapy type and energy type were submitted in just one field. In these cases, Untransformed Radiation Therapy Type will appear identical to Untransformed Radiation Energy Type, and Radiation Therapy Type will contain any radiation therapy type information that could be harmonized to that CDE.
